newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nov French car sales seen sharply lower - paper.
newsitem.headline: Nov French car sales seen sharply lower - paper.

text.p: Car industry sources estimate new car sales in France fell more than 20 percent in November from year-earlier levels, the newspaper Le Figaro said on Saturday.
It said industry sources estimate around 140,000 car registrations for November, compared with 173,300 last November which was already a nine percent drop from 1994 levels.
The slide reflects a fall in demand following the expiry on September 30 of a state new-cars-for-old rebate scheme.
The French carmakers association CCFA will report provisional November car sales on Monday at 1100 GMT.
